notes:
Short summary: enterprise support platform. heavy ticket volume (multi-tenant customers). wants to reduce live-agent volume via deflection and high-precision suggestions. key metrics: scale ~30M indexed doc variants (KB + transcripts + policy docs), avg queries/day 120k, peak QPS 45. Target latency: end-to-end retrieval+rerank P95 <= 200ms (goal 120ms). Cost target: <$0.02/query blended (embedding + rerank + model inference).

Architecture preferences / asks:
- prefer VPC with private control plane (sensitive customers asking for residency in NA + EU).
- embedding store can be a managed vector DB but want advice on co-locating nearest to Dedicated pool to hit latency SLOs.
- reranker: cross-encoder for Top-5 re-rank (aim NDCG@5 >= 0.85). will consider two-stage: ANN recall -> small cross-encoder rerank on GPU.
- model choice: open quantized models for embedding and rerank (Llama-family 13B/34B eq for rerank), small encoder for recall. Interested in Redwood catalog suggestions + quantization profiles.
- caching: aggressive prefix + hot-query caching; wants guidance from Redwood Optimize to minimize tokens.

POC goals / success criteria:
- show <200ms P95 for retrieval+Top-5 rerank on Dedicated pool with 30M vectors (synthetic load).
- demonstrate rerank quality: Top-5 precision/ NDCG targets as above on 3 customer datasets.
- cost model showing how batching and quantization reduce cost to target.

Sales notes / quotes:
- CSM/Buyer (VP Product): "Latency is non-negotiable for chat handoff — sub-200ms or we keep local heuristics."
- Eng Dir: "We will run a 2-week production-like POC; need help tuning kv-cache and batch sizes."

use_case_details: Ticket deflection + agent assist. Primary flow: customer query -> ANN recall (fast) -> cross-encoder rerank (Top-5) -> final candidate selection + short-gen answer. Must preserve sub-200ms P95 at 45 QPS peaks. Index size ~30M vectors, metadata + embeddings refresh cadence nightly or incremental for support transcripts.
technical_requirements:
- Index scale: 30M vectors, expected growth 25% qtrly.
- Storage: vector DB co-located with Dedicated GPU pool preferred.
- Latency SLOs: P95 retrieval+rerank <=200ms; P99 <400ms desirable.
- Rerank quality: NDCG@5 >= 0.85 on eval sets.
- Failover: automatic fallback to smaller reranker/CPU if GPU capacity constrained.
- Security: SSO, audit logs, KMS integration, data residency in NA/EU.
procurement_notes: Procurement prefers an annual committed Dedicated contract. Interested in commit tiers and burst pricing. Finance requested scenario: 12-month, 2x baseline capacity, with an option to add private deployment in EU in year 2.
internal_replication_flags: High-touch account; needs SE ramp and dedicated PO. POC will require Redwood Optimize involvement for batching/caching recommendations.
